steps.en: Suspension is triggered after the Cumulus receipt arrives
steps.id: Suspend dipicu setelah receipt Cumulus diterima
steps.why_en: Suspension runs right when staff save the payment, not after a Cumulus receipt.
steps.why_id: Suspend langsung jalan saat staff menyimpan pembayaran, bukan setelah receipt Cumulus.

steps.en: Notice is marked permanently suspended as paid
steps.id: Notice ditandai suspend permanen sebagai lunas

steps.en: The suspension is recorded in the suspension history
The paid status is also sent to the public portal data
steps.id: Status lunas juga dikirim ke data portal publik

steps.en: The notice does not escalate to the next stage
steps.id: Notice tidak eskalasi ke stage berikutnya
steps.why_en: Only two stage checks were confirmed, and partly paid notices also stop escalating.
steps.why_id: Baru dua pengecekan stage yang terkonfirmasi, dan notice yang baru dibayar sebagian juga berhenti eskalasi.
